reviews.label: within_intentional_grader_slack
reviews.rationale: Relabelled 2026-10-19 (was required_gap): Instruction: recover rows as {"word","value"}; mutant blanks the word of recovered row testword08. The test scores 8 rows (testword02-09) and passes at >6 matches. The 4096-byte trunc.db cuts off inside testword00/01, which the test deliberately omits, and testword08/09 are stored as 8-byte IEEE doubles while 02-07 are 1-byte integers, so a 7/8 threshold tolerates exactly one mis-decoded row.
